mapper.sql: r.RECOVERY_ID, r.RECOVERY_NO, r.WRITE_OFF_ID, r.CUSTOMER_ID, r.RECOVERY_AMOUNT, r.RECOVERY_DATE, r.RECOVERY_REASON, r.REMARKS, r.TENANT_ID, r.ORG_ID, r.CREATE_TIME, r.CREATE_BY, r.UPDATE_TIME, r.UPDATE_BY, r.IS_DELETED
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_RECOVERY r WHERE r.IS_DELETED = 0 AND r.WRITE_OFF_ID = #{writeOffId}

SELECT COUNT(1) as recoveryCount, NVL(SUM(RECOVERY_AMOUNT), 0) as totalRecoveryAmount FROM TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_RECOVERY WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId}

SELECT #{prefix} || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(RECOVERY_NO, -4))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_RECOVERY WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND RECOVERY_NO LIKE #{prefix} || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '%'
